_comment: Game expression -> engine settings. chatterbox: [exaggeration, cfg_weight] (user-tested 2026-11-19). intense = expressions acted with the expressive Qwen style; strong = the introvert adjustment is not applied (Blue still yells when she yells).

qwen.style: Natural, believable voice acting for a stylized fantasy game; grounded and warm, not squeaky, not whiny, not exaggerated, no anime-style squealing; adult voices only.
qwen.intense_style: Expressive, emotionally intense voice acting for a fantasy game; fully committed performance, adult woman (about 20), never childlike or squeaky.
